description: This Java source file defines the AuthorizeResponse class, which processes and interprets responses from the Authorize.Net payment gateway. It encapsulates response data parsing, provides methods to retrieve specific response fields (like transaction ID, response code, authorization code, etc.), and determines approval status.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse
classes.description: Main class for parsing and handling Authorize.Net response data, providing methods to access response fields, approval status, and raw response.

methods.name: AuthorizeResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing the response object with response string, delimiter, and response type.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an approved transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Returns the transaction ID from the response.

methods.name: getAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Returns the authorization code from the response.

methods.name: getAvsResult
methods.description: Returns the AVS (Address Verification Service) result code.

methods.name: getCvResult
methods.description: Returns the CVV (Card Verification Value) result code.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getResponseField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific response field by its name, based on position mapping.
